name: Milton Friedman
role: American economist (1912–2006), Nobel laureate and free-market advocate
summary: An economist who argued for limited government, free markets and free trade, a legislated rule for money in place of discretionary central banking, school vouchers and a negative income tax in place of the welfare system. He opposed minimum wages, price controls, licensure, conscription, farm supports and compulsory social security, and defended voluntary exchange as the basis of political freedom.
